name: garminconnect-mcp
long_description:
Talk to Claude to build Garmin workouts (running, cycling, swimming, strength, HIIT and more), schedule them and send them to your watch, and to read your sleep, HRV, stress, training readiness, activities and the rest of your Garmin Connect data.

Sign in once through a page that opens in your browser; your password goes only to Garmin. Everything runs on your computer.

Unofficial: not made by, or affiliated with, Garmin.

groups.title: Tool groups
groups.description: Optional. Comma-separated groups to load: activities, badges-challenges, body-composition-weight, courses, devices, gear, golf, metrics, profile-and-misc, wellness, womens-health, workouts. Empty loads everything. Fewer groups use less of Claude's context. Unknown names are ignored; if none you list are valid, everything loads.

download_dir.title: Download folder
download_dir.description: Optional. Where downloaded activity and workout files are saved. Empty uses Downloads/garmin.

enable_graphql.title: Raw GraphQL tool
enable_graphql.description: Expose the unrestricted Garmin GraphQL tool. Off unless you need it.

tools.name: sign_in_to_garmin
tools.description: Sign in to Garmin Connect through a page in your browser.

tools.name: preview_workout
tools.description: Show a workout in readable form without saving it.

tools.name: create_workout
tools.description: Save a workout to your Garmin workout library.

tools.name: search_exercises
tools.description: Find Garmin exercise names for strength and HIIT steps.
